query: MiniMax text chat models list: model ids for chat completions (MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, minimax-m3.1-flash, MiniMax-M3, M2.1) with context length, max output tokens, reasoning support, tool/function calling, pricing; which model id corresponds to 'minimax-m3.1-flash' on NVIDIA build.nvidia.com NIM?
response:
### API Overview > Large Language Model
Source: https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/api-overview
Supported Models table:
| Model Name | Context Window | Description |
| MiniMax-M3.1-Flash | 1,000,000 | Frontier multimodal coding model with 1M context window and tunable thinking depth |
| MiniMax-M3 | 1,000,000 | Frontier multimodal coding model with 1M context window |
Note: the maximum token count refers to the total of input and output tokens.

### POST /v1/chat/completions
Source: https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/text-chat-openai
- model enum: `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash`, `MiniMax-M3`.
- Supports text, image, video, and tool call content; streaming; thinking behavior; token limits.
- **thinking** (object): `adaptive` default. For `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash`, always thinks; `disabled` returns HTTP 400. For `MiniMax-M3`, adaptive thinking on by default; `disabled` skips thinking. For M2.x, `disabled` accepted but ignored.
- **reasoning_effort**: only `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` supports real thinking-depth tuning; others ignore it. Default `max`. `none` is not accepted and returns HTTP 400. Options: low, medium, high, xhigh, max.
- **reasoning_split**: when true, thinking content separated into `reasoning_content`; when false, kept in content wrapped in thinking tags. `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` does not support setting this to false.
- **max_completion_tokens**: for M3.1-Flash and M3 recommended 131072 (128K), maximum 524288 (512K).
- **temperature / top_p**: not supported yet; M3.1-Flash and M3 always use temperature 1, top_p 0.95.
- **tools** (object[]): function tools are supported.
- **service_tier**: standard/priority; `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` does not support this field.

### Anthropic-compatible text chat
Source: https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/text-chat-anthropic
MiniMax-M3.1-Flash and MiniMax-M3 are multimodal (text, image, video) with native tool use and thinking content blocks; M3.1-Flash additionally always thinks and supports tunable thinking depth via `output_config.effort`.

### CLI / model list
Source: https://platform.minimax.io/docs/m-plan/other-tools
`omp models minimax` confirms `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` in the model list; `omp --model minimax/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash:max`.
note: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash: 1M context, always-thinks, reasoning_effort low..max (none->400), max_completion_tokens max 512K, tools supported, multimodal [official-doc]. NIM id minimaxai/minimax-m3.1-flash from local provider config. Local usage: 15 calls, TTFT ~11.3s, avg turn ~128s, 9 errors — slow+flaky.
